def Donate (T : Towers L) (α C : ℝ) (K : ℕ) := ∀ l : List Axis,l.length ≤ K →
    (advanceC L T.A0 l).strip α (C/(L.val:ℝ)^(1+l.length)) ∧ (advanceC L T.T l).strip α (C/(L.val:ℝ)^(2+l.length))

proof_context.conclusion: For every list l of at most K axes, the iterated difference `advanceC L T.A0 l` of the interpolation has `strip alpha (C / L^(1+length l))`, an exponentially weighted summed bound with the ell^{-1-r} scaling.

def HopQuote (K : KernelChoices) (j t : ℕ) (m l σ η C : ℝ) (b : ℕ) := ∀ P : Flight j t,
    let k := K.penalty
    let W := P.rollFunds k m l
    Donate (P.duo k) σ C (j-2) ∧ W.strip σ C ∧ (b ≤ P.L.val → Funds W η C)

proof_context.conclusion: For every `Flight` of stages (j,t), `Donate (P.duo k) sigma C (j-2)` holds with constants independent of the ratio and history, from `Free.pledges`.
